# {{ site.title }}

> {{ home.description | strip_newlines }}

The Finance Toolkit calculates 1100+ financial metrics (ratios, valuation and risk models, performance, technical indicators, options, fixed income, econometrics and macroeconomic data) with transparent, documented formulas. The Finance Database classifies 300,000+ stocks, ETFs and indices by sector, industry, country and more. Both are free and open source, and both run as MCP servers so Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants can use them.

## Finance Toolkit Documentation

Every function has its own page with the formula, the parameters, a Python example and a question to ask through the MCP server, under the module's address (for example {{ site.url }}/projects/financetoolkit/docs/performance/sharpe-ratio). Every method page, with a one-line description, is listed in [{{ site.url }}/llms-financetoolkit-docs.txt]({{ site.url }}/llms-financetoolkit-docs.txt). The modules:
